newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bangchak awards heavy high-sulphur crude in tender.
newsitem.headline: Bangchak awards heavy high-sulphur crude in tender.

text.p: Thailand's Bangchak Petroleum Plc refinery purchased by tender 500,000 barrels of a heavy high-sulphur Middle East crude in its February buying tender, a refinery source said on Monday.
Bangchak was negotiating bilaterally for the purchase of some other crudes, including Tapis, the source said.
Bangchak tendered last week to buy 500,000 barrels of Middle East crude and 600,000 barrels of light sweet regional crude for its 120,000 barrels-per-day refinery.
Bangchak traditionally buys Oman crude in its tenders, but no Oman was offered.
The source declined to specify which crude Bangchak had awarded, but said it was done at a single digit premium.
